nom: COSRX The AHA 2 BHA 2 Blemish Treatment Serum

avis.texte: I bought this for my teenage son who has been struggling with acne. We have tried numerous other products with little to no results and we've tried prescription creams that only made his face itch. This product began clearing up his face witnin days of first use and has minimized his break outs. I am so happy we have found this product and cannot say enough about the positive results! I highly recommend!

avis.titre: Love it, but my skin dreads it
avis.texte: Super effective, does exactly what it's supposed to do. Well worth it. Just note if you have sensitive skin this product is hard on it. Right after using it, my skin is pretty red and angry. I have to use more moisturizer than usual to prevent getting dry flaky skin the following day. I also skip all other products at nighttime in order to prevent additional irritation. I can also only tolerate it 1x/week. I tried 2x/week but it was too much. Could be my use of adapaline 6x/week but im pretty sure it's because my skin is just sensitive.
I have dry and oily skin. This product works like a dream and absolutely helps to clear up and prevent both big and little bumps. I wish I would have found it sooner!!!

Purchased based on reviews and I can honestly say this product works. I am 57 with chronic stubborn nose pores that have been difficult to fix. They are now empty, the pores are shrinking and my skin looks so so much better. Highly recommend!

I have PCOS and I have struggles with acne to this day. I've spent a lot of time finding products to help with it, I have never seen such immediate and great results. My hormonal chin acne is still a struggle but this fights against it as much as it can and sometimes over night. The rest of my face however has not broken out at all and after like a week of using it you can tell my pores are so much cleaner and smooth. My skin just feels healthier and its easier to apply my makeup!! Oh yes and if u use it with ur makeup it doesnt cause any pilling in my experience. Anyways i love her.
This got rid of a stubborn acne scar that was in between my brow. It would go away after a chemical peel but then come back. Now its gone.

i use this serum at night and target around my nose, forehead and chin where all my pores/skin problems are. i notice the next day that they are visibly smaller and less clogged. i use this about once/twice a week and it has lasted me months! the cotton and tweezers are a nice touch

i use this serum at night and target around my nose, forehead and chin where all my pores/skin problems are. i notice the next day that they are visibly smaller and less clogged. i use this about once/twice a week and it has lasted me months! the cotton and tweezers are a nice touch
I have only been using this product for the last week or so and I am very impressed with it. My blemishes are healing really fast after application. I have used it in the evenings.

I get these tiny whiteheads on both sides of my chin & jaw area that are extremely stubborn because they are so small but this product right here has been the only thing to get rid of them & I've tried alot of products. My only complaint is i dont care for the little cotton things because i ise them all over my face & dont use it just on the spots. I think i will just leave it in the original bottle mext time I repurchase. So if you are struggling like o was i would definitely give them a try. This is not sponsored & I bought with my own money. This is my own honest review.

This serum is said to quickly and easily soothe acne-scarred skin and instantly care for blackheads, whiteheads, and clogged pores. This also is supposed to be a gentle serum that helps with rough skin texture. This comes in a handy flip top container that has little cotton balls, and plastic tweezers in it. You simply pour the full serum into the cotton ball container, and use the tweezers to pickup each cotton ball for easy access. I've only been using this for 1 week and for the use of clogged pores I have. I've found that my pores look so much better with this product. I just dabbed the cotton ball on my nose area where my clogged pores are, and let it work! I did get a small pimple 1 day, and immediately applied it as soon as I saw it that night. By the morning it was gone! I think if you catch your pimple early enough this really works wonders. I have not experienced any breakouts from using this and my skin looks great. I personally did not get any sticky feeling either and felt it absorbed great into my skin. Make sure you use sunscreen if you use in the daytime. So far I'm very happy with this product and can't wait to see the results with continued use.

avis.titre: I would buy it again and again thank you 💫🫶
avis.texte: I am really loving this beauty product very effective in short time of using 🌺💫💫💫💫💫💫👌

avis.titre: I would to buy this product again 💫🫶
avis.texte: Super effective product I am really impressed with this product made my skin look like glass thank you 🌺🌺💫🫶

I absolutely love The Alpha-Arbutin 2% Discoloration Care Serum! I've always struggled with red discoloration under my chin and pimple scars, but they started fading as soon as I began using this. It's been a game-changer for my skin. Highly recommend!

I get hormonal acne that takes about a week to go away after my womens week , which isnt much downtome between womens week before my next visitiors show up. Usually it appears either on my chin or on the left hand sidd of my face . I used one cotton ball in the morning and one at night . Its been two days and you can visibly tell the pimples have gotten smaller . My face feels smoother when i apply my other products. There is a slight sting but nothing too terrible . Will buy again
I just love this product. Thanks God that such wonderful product exists

When I get a pimple, I use it right after washing up in the evening. If I apply it at night and go to sleep, the pimple is gone by the next morning. It was amazing to see such quick results. While more developed pimples take a bit longer to calm down, this product is truly the best for early-stage breakouts.
Works well, very easy to use with the cotton balls and convenient packaging.
I like this product. I use it primarily as a spot treatment. It dries out a breakout and prevents others from surfacing. I use it after I clean my face and before toner or after toner. .
I really love the product. I use it on my pimples at night and it helps reduce the redness and inflammation overnight.
The Blemish treatment serum helps reduce the inflammation of my pimples. I love it!!!!

I really love this product! I love the packaging and application. The little cotton balls make it super easy to apply. I use it at night on my blemishes as the last part of my skincare routine and it really does seem to control my acne and makes my breakouts less noticeable when I wake up in the morning. I would definitely recommend this product!
I see the reduction of my acne and blemishes. This is by far the best treatment.

Extremely calming for tough sudden breakouts. I usually get the same two cystic acne pimples on my chin, they usually take over a week to calm down. I started using this blemish treatment on my chin and it has helped so much! My cystic acne pimples disappear in 2 days.

avis.titre: Easy to use and packed full of serum
avis.texte: Each cotton ball is full of serum, I usually squeeze some out so that it doesn't drip everywhere. I have been using it for almost 2 months now and it has been helping with my chin and neck when I get small acne bumps but it doesn't really help with the larger cystic acne bumps I sometimes get. Overall it has been helping with reducing the size and redness from my acne.

Cosrx always does a great job creating products that truly do exactly what they claim. This is a great spot treatment that does a wonderful job drying out blemishes. The balls definitely have more liquid than you need, and it can feel wasteful. However, I'd rather have too much than not enough. Definitely helps calm down my spots.
These were so convenient to use, just hoping they don't dry out over time!
Great target treatment! It does help calm and flatten my big hormone ance.

Have used these on acne/whiteheads as soon as they appear and I do think it helps lessen the time it takes for them to go away. There is quite a bit of serum in each ball so I first tried using it all over my face for exfoliation but realized it was too potent as it tingle and then dried out my face the following days, so only use it now on the actual whitehead and oily tzone to clear up my pores. I think it helps. (I use many different products together so can't be certain it's this that's working exclusively but I do like it and will continue to use on my breakouts).
The package is very cute and effective for traveling. Instead of bringing all my serums on vacation, I can just use the individual cotton balls. Each one also holds a lot of product!

Works excellent in conjunction with or without pimple patch. Greatly speeds up the disappearing process of the blemish. My skin did not get irritated at all, but I did drop a few of the cotton balls using the tweezers. When I am out, I will repurchase.
Took care of a blind pimple overnight. By the third application, it was completely gone before it ever erupted. Dries the skin but that's to be expected from such a strong product.

This is such a soothing product, and I have really been enjoy using it. The tongs and tiny cotton ball function can take a bit of practice to get used to it (maybe it will one day be available in a liquid form!) but once you get the hang of it it feels moisturizing and so far I'm seeing positive results.

This stuff is really good! It works best when you just use it as a spot treatment instead of all over your face. The only reason I am giving it 4 stars is because it is pretty difficult to hold with the tweeErs they give you. But all in all I do see a difference in my pores a bit and my pimples

I was skeptical when I saw the other reviews but it really works! I felt a cystic pimple coming up and used this overnight and it was reduced the very next morning and surfaced shortly after. Wish I got this before, it's a game changer

This works really well as a spot treatment, and I find myself using it much more consistently because of how convenient it is. Every cotton balls is soaked with serum, so you get a lot of coverage even with just one ball. I'll definitely keep using this in the future!

I really like this product. I use it a few times a week and I've noticed a difference. It's not harsh and doesn't burn. I also really like how cute it is also. The little cotton balls are such a cute idea to me

I'm was very skeptical as to whether this product would work or not. It does have an unconventional method to apply it BUT it works great! I would even say it's magical because it works so well on stubborn acne flare ups. The solution is extremely effective on acne that other products could not treat. I was truly shocked and very impressed. I've yet to find a single product from COSRX that I didn't love.

Overall I hold a very positive view on this product. When used as directed, on whiteheads or black heads, it clearly works and really limits swelling or irritation, especially on my deep pores. You want to make sure to use it on a targeted area(s), otherwise I've had some breakout effects on non-affected areas. I do wish the included tweezers were a bit stronger, as I have dropped the product in the sink. Regardless, it's nice that the tweezers are included because it's clear that this is a product that should not be handled with your fingers. I like it and it works.
This was definitely something I bought on a whim but has become a new favorite item. It has so much product in one little cotton ball it's amazing. Will definitely buy again.
I just started using this product , but I actually really like it . I had a couple of pimples due to being that time of the month and this helped me get rid of those pimples .
Got this product to help with the redness of my acne. It's super easy to use and so far I am very happy with it. It reduced the size of my pimples drastically by the end of the day.

I really like this product. It's unique and different than regular serums. I really like that they include little tweezers to pick up the product with to avoid germs and bacteria getting onto the little cotton balls you haven't used yet. I use one every night and have seen a significant difference so far as well as less new acne appearing. Goes really well with the snail mucin cream as well.

This formula is gentle enough for daily use, which I love. It feels like a mix between a toner and an essence, so it's nice and light. I didn't notice a huge difference in my blackheads, but I believe I'd need to use it longer to see how it helps with those. It did help gently clear my breakout though.

I have a lot of pimples on my face, which can't be cured by going to a beauty salon. It doesn't help to buy a lot of skin care products. Since I tried this product, the pimples on my face are disappearing and decreasing day by day. I will continue to use it until my face is completely better, and I have confidence in it.

I have been using this product for about 3 weeks, as needed. I left the seal on the package to store the tweezers. There is ample amount of serum in each cotton ball that I will use 1 cotton 3 times (storing it on the foil seal) I have sensitive skin and hormonal acne. I use this and see results the following day. I'm a big fan of the product and the delivery system.

Honestly the formula is pretty effective. However keep in mind that this is an aha and bha so this will interrupt your retinol schedule. Also I find that one cotton ball is too much for one pimple so I use a q-tip and dip it into the jar to prolong the use of this product.

I received this product as a part of a promotion, but my review is honest. I've tested the serum on and off for over two weeks. I reach for it whenever I need to spot-treat an area of concern, and it fills a nice niche in my routine. When I received this serum, I had a mild but stubborn outbreak along my chin, and since it has mostly cleared.

All good so far. I tried it on a few pimples that I had popped I noticed they're less inflamed and irritated and surprisingly it didn't burn when I applied it. It isn't drying and has no fragrance I love that. The only con for me is I only use a little at a time on small areas and there's still so much product left in the cotton ball and I have nowhere else use the excess serum. Also I like that it comes with the applicator tongs so you won't have to put your hands in the container or touch your face to apply it very sanitary.
I have hormonal acne that has been on and off for years. I think this serum is helping, I've only used it for a week or so. my only issue is that it takes a really long time to dry.

This serum doesn't sting and applies very smoothly. However, the tongs aren't the most effective in squeezing the product out so it feels like some product gets wasted. This can easily be solved by using your fingers.

This my new LOVE!!! I have cystic acne. I used this treatment on the inflamed areas around my face. The next morning, the size of the inflamed areas were reduced by 75%! I was amazed at the overnight results! As the week progressed, my breakouts healed. Very happy with the results so far.

avis.titre: Love the serum, not the application
avis.texte: The cotton balls are loaded with serum, which means you either luck out and have plenty to apply to a large area, or end up wasting it on just one spot. The tongs are great for picking them out of the jar but I find it easy to drop the ball trying to maneuver it into other positions. It's too soon to tell how it will affect pore congestion but it works quickly on inflamed blemishes.
Love the packaging and the tweezers! The little cotton balls are so cute. Really enjoyed the cool feeling of the serum being applied & that it doesn't feel drying.

avis.titre: Price is right if you want to give this a try
avis.texte: I've only used this for a week but already see some results where bumps are less apparent and I haven't broken out. The individual swabs are a great size for spot treatment, but they are soaked with too much essence. I squeeze out the excess and will decant to prolong usage. My skin is sensitive so if i use this, I skip my other products for acne. I still get redness so I use it at night. I hope with longer use, this product will improve my rough cheeks.

I absolutely love the packaging on this product. The tweezers are genius and the little cotton balls are so cute. I love the cool feeling of the serum being applied and that it doesn't feel drying at all. I haven't used it enough to gauge results yet but definitely looking forward to continue using this!

avis.titre: Application could use a little tweaking
avis.texte: Like some reviews have said, the cotton swabs can be a little tricky to handle, but the product works well! I have been using this on my back acne for about 2 weeks and it has cleared my breakouts without drying my skin out. One swab goes a long way. These are easy to travel with as well- I threw a few cotton swabs in a travel container to treat breakouts while away. For the price its worth trying for yourself.

I tried this product out for two weeks, 3 days a week. Before the product arrived I had developed two big pimples on my face and had some white heads on my chin. During the first week this serum had brought the pimples to the head making it ready to use a pimple patch on. As for the whiteheads on my chin, they are still there but they are not as textured as they were before.

avis.titre: Used for 2 weeks and noticed a difference
avis.texte: I have used this for 2 weeks straight and did see a difference. 1 cotton has so much product that I was able to use on other areas, but I manly focused on new blemishes around my neck and jawline. After using it for 2 weeks it dried out the blemish and shrunk in size. Definitely going to keep using on my
My daughter used it she has acne prone skin and she and I loved it! Her skin improved a lot! She's more confident now that her skin has improved

I'm still evaluating the long term benefit of this product, but so far I'm liking it. The cottonballs are an easy, unique, and hygienic delivery method to help keep the product and your skin from being contaminated. The product applied easily, with no stinging or burning, leaving behind a slightly serum-y residue. One cottonball contains more than enough serum for a number of blemishes or trouble spots- I actually used leftover product for KP on my arms. That being said, I wish the cottonballs were slightly smaller. For the price, it's worth it to give this product a try, especially if targeted application of trouble spots is desired. I'm interested in continuing to use it to evaluate it long term.

This is a great product to spot treat any blemishes and pimples . The jar is filled with small cotton balls, soaked in ample amount of serum. I appreciate the tweezer that it came with, providing a dedicated and hygienic way to grab the cotton balls. I used this product on my arms for 14 days and it cleared the keratosis pilaris (small bumps) I've always had. I also used it on my nose and it cleared the whiteheads. Overall, it is a great product, but I would prefer the serum to be soaked in pads instead of small cotton balls.

Using for blemishes with adult cystic acne I was amazed at how quickly this helped reduce redness and with reduction in size. I have noticed a bit less of sebum over my nose and less blackheads but I cycle this with other skincare any only use 2-3 times a week (I have sensitive skin). Only con is so much serum is in one cotton boll i feel it a waste and putting it back into container defeats the purpose of a hygienic way to put on this produc.my. Overall I will purchase again and I recommend it for spot treatment of acne and reducing sebum/blackheads!

I enjoyed using this product on my acne.However, it does leave my face slightly red after use. I wouldn't say it was irritated, but my skin was definitely a little sensitive. Overall I did enjoy this product

I've used this product around three times but I have already seen a change to my skin. This product has mainly helped reduce the blemishes from my inflamed and hormonal acne which I have been trying to get rid of for months now! This product has also minimized my blackheads and some of my whiteheads. However, I'm giving this four stars because I do find that you may waste some product since each cotton ball is very saturated with the serum but other than that I have seen a significant change in my skin. Also, I have not experienced any itching or burning and I have not had any breakouts from using this product. I think my blemishes and other skin concerns will continue to minimize as I continue using this treatment! ü´∂

avis.titre: Works good, feels a bit wasteful
avis.texte: The product itself is very good, only have been using it for about a week or so, but like the results so far. The thongs are a bit flimsy. The cotton balls are soaked in the product and it does feels wasteful since little goes a long way.

I was truly expecting to have little to no immediate effect. I have tried dozens of "immediate results" products with the realistic observation of a slight improvement after multiple uses over several days. When I tried this product, I assumed the same thing but NO - literally cleared my skin in about 20 minutes! I genuinely thought it was a fluke until it happened again during my next breakout. I literally chose not to take a before picture because I have never had a use for one (since it never feels authentic) but wow I really wish I documented it better for picture proof. I will say that my biggest and only gripe is that there is a lot of product in each little cotton ball - which doesn't sound like a complaint, until you have used one cotton ball for all of your issue areas and realize you just have to waste a lot of unused product since you cant just put the used ball back into the rest of the unused ones.

I received this product as part of a review. The application was easy, I love that the product is already soaked into mini cotton balls. After 2 applications it brought redness down & reduced the size of pimples on my cheek. Will be buying again!

avis.titre: Buy this is you suffer from random break outs
avis.texte: Wow COSRX really hits everything you need in every product they sell. I started to break out and got these magical cubes and let me tell you within 24 hours my acne was way smaller and then 48 hours later completely gone.

I had a few whiteheads that I accidentally opened and used this product to treat them. I worked really well in combination with the Cosrx patches and got rid of the swelling and redness overnight, I like how sanitary it is.

While I've only had the product for a short time, I've noticed that will smaller pimples that after one use they decrease by 50 percent and the inflammation is also drastically reduced. I've had one cystic pimple and i don't feel that it worked well for that. Since using this product, I do feel like my breakouts has lessened, although I need more time with the product to truly know the impacts on my skin, although it seems very promising.

great spot treatment ! it dramatically reduced redness overnight on problem areas and application feels nice. it can be a bit difficult to hold on to the dots with the little tweezers. I think for the price and amount of product i would purchase again.

The one thing that I was skeptical about was how watery the product would be. The consistency of the product reminded me of an essence. I was on the lookout for any signs of irritation, so far there are none. The overall effectiveness of the product gets a 7.5/10. It helped calm some stubborn pimples that I would get around my hairline. Would purchase in the future.

I am still testing out the effects of this product, but I wanted to share that within 1 day I had a noticeable difference in a prominent white head on my forehead. It was visibly reduced in size, smoother, and no more pain. I plan to continue to use this and will report back with additional feedback after 2 weeks with before and after photos.

Worked well on my whitehead. I applied this product 2-3x on an inflamed area and my skin got better after. Not sure I understand why cosrx designed this product to be applied using balls, though. Each ball has a LOT of product, which felt wasteful as I only had a few problem areas at a time. Unless my whole face was covered in blemishes, I would never use the entire amount per ball.

I have used this product for more than a week straight, and I have noticed a decrease in blackheads on my nose, not overnight, but from continuous use. I also had a pimple right next to my nose and the first night after using it on it the pimple significantly less inflamed. Altogether, my skin looks and feels way clearer/less congested! Great product if used consistently!! the only thing keeping me from giving it 5 stars is that the cotton balls are so big, and so full of product that it feels wasteful to use a single ball when you only consume a bit of the serum per application. Perhaps COSRX should make the cotton balls much smaller.

I will say that I am very happy with this container and the application of the product itself. The whole package is recyclable and the balls are great for application, but there is a lot of serum. The serum itself is so soothing and great. I love that even though it seems like something that would sting, it doesn't! Of course I didn't see immediate results, but the treatment takes time. Just swab over a pimple and your good to go!

The product does seem to work to dry any pimples or blemishes, especially when caught still beneath the surface. I'm not sure on the single-use system, as I felt like I went through the little balls a bit quickly.

I've had a cluster of acne on my neck for a while now that people just can't resist not commenting on...now I just have a few dark spots that will fade soon! Packaging is really unique and fun! Would repurchase

This product is not too drying for my oily combo skin. I used it twice a day for two days for a breakout. I like the delivery system. Tongs could be easier to use. I used clean hands and rotated the cotton to maximize product use.
I have been using this product for 2 weeks and have been loving it. Great for blemishes & whiteheads!

Saw a slight improvement with my skin, but requires consistent usage (not an overnight fix type of product). I have a pretty sensitive skin barrier so I was nervous about this, but it was gentle enough that I had no problems! The packaging is sanitary but does feel wasteful - there's so much product in each cotton pad.
This product soothed my hormonal adult acne. The product did not burn or irritate my face. I noticed a reduction in redness and my texture was even softened. I would highly recommend.

This serum is definitely effective, it removed whiteheads from my face in a day if I use it day and night without causing any further irritation which I think is amazing. My only disappointment is there is a LOT of serum packed into each ball, and even if I use it excessively, only half the serum is necessary for my face. I saw someone else in the reviews say they use the rest for their KP, which is a great idea, but I didn't really know what to do with all the excess and threw it out, which felt wasteful. It's a great product, I just wish it came in a dropper bottle instead so I can use how much I need. Still, this definitely delivers what it promises, which is a gentle but effective acne solution, so I do recommend!

avis.titre: An innovative spot treatment for the summer.
avis.texte: I feel like during the summer time I go for products that don't need to be rubbed in and or worked into the skin to work. I feel like the sponge is a different kind of of applicator to get use to, but it is still effective. The fact that it can minimize breakouts by the next day is amazing. As long as you stay on top of hydrating your skin as well. This was a fun experience as well because not a lot spot treatments look like this.

I found the product so easy to use. I loved the tweezers being included. The ball had just enough product on it. It did not drip down the face. It was not harsh on my sometimes sensitive skin. I didn't give it 5 stars since it didn't take away my spot. I thought it was a white head but maybe it's something different. I appreciate that I could sample this product for review.

I used this product every other day for two weeks, and I saw results after using it twice. I have textured skin on my forehead and this made my skin smoother. When I applied this on my acne they went away in two to three days. I usually breakout with AHA's and BHA's but I didn't with this product. I will buy this again!

avis.titre: Great product but tongs are annoying
avis.texte: The product itself is great. The serum was gentle and didn't sting. I also visibly saw my pimples go down, but the tongs are extremely annoying to use. The delivery system is just not the best.

Had a few oncoming pimples when I received The AHA 2 BHA 2 Blemish Treatment Serum. It worked great to reduce the size of the irritated bumps. It didn't dry out my skin too much compared to other acne-type treatments that I've tried.

I really liked how much product came out of each cotton ball. I received a complimentary product and had used it for over a week. Within that week, I did see results. My blackheads + whiteheads weren't as visible + I didn't feel the need to extract/exfoliate around my nose area as much. I also liked to apply the product along my t-zone areas. I am not too sure, but I did notice that I don't get as oily as much throughout the day, which is a plus! But, I wasn't really able to tell the difference when I had makeup on. I did notice that this product was reallllly drying, so I would keep the use to a minimum or around treatment areas only in the future, or increase/layer your moisturizer twice. I really like the idea of the product, but using the applicator was quite a task. I figured after a few days of testing that the tonns was only good to pick up the cottom ball hygenically from the container and used my fingers to pick it up and apply it to my problem areas.

I have been using this for the past two weeks on any emerging pimples as well as on my nose and chin where blackheads tend to form, since yes, there is quite a lot of product on each cotton ball. I have sensitive skin and this did not irritate me at all. Emerging pimples seemed to stay small and go away a bit faster than normal. I did not notice a big difference in regard to the blackheads. The tongs were a nice way to pick up the cotton balls but I ended up using my fingers to hold and apply the product. I can't decide if the cotton balls are a nice convenient option, or if it would be easier to tell this as a toner and let folks choose their method of application. Regardless, it's a nice product and I'm happy to continue using it

I throughly enjoyed this product for my acne. It helped my redness and irritation with my acne. It has helped to calm it down. I do have to say it a little strong so I would use it 2-3 times a week instead of every day.

I used the AHA 2 BHA 2 Blemish Treatment Serum on two white heads. One cleared up in one day and the other cleared up in two days. There was no drying effect or redness on the application sights. Very effective and fast acting blemish control that is not harsh.

This product is great ! I had acne on my face and it went away in 2 days of usage. My face started to appear brighten which means my blemishes were fading and additionally I haven't had any blackheads since using it. Great product and easy to use. In the photo , top is before and bottom is after

I have always suffered from sensitive, acne-prone skin. Naturally, with temperatures rising I have been worried about clogged pores and this treatment has greatly helped! I've seen reduction (and in some cases, complete removal) of clogged pores, red spots, whiteheads, and general irritation. I was a bit concerned about my skin becoming dry from usage, but I always follow with a moisturizer and sunscreen and have nev er had any problems with flaking or extreme reactions. I love this product and it really is a life saver for when youre in a pinch!

honestly i was pleasantly surprised by this! i had a small cluster of acne on my upper cheek and used this 2 days in a row on the spot (followed with sunscreen in the morning) and in that time the spots shrunk and got way less red! really happy with that, also i like the application. at first i wondered if it was a little gimmicky, but i like the little balls and tongs for spot application compared to trying to target a small area with a pump serum. i feel like this was really effective, and can even be used safely in a routine with retinal (used on different days of course). i think this is worth the money for sure.

I really like these! I get hormonal acne on my chin with my cycle and these worked really well for spot applying to trouble areas. The formula is really nice, it's effective but not too harsh. I do wish they were smaller, maybe even half the size. I feel a little wasteful if I only have a few spots to apply to. Which is really not a big deal, I'll just start cutting them in half.

When I first received this product I thought it might be a little gimmicky given the tweezer and cotton ball format, but I am actually really pleased with it! I have been plagued with small blackheads on my cheeks for months and months now, and nothing was clearing them up. I started using this consistently at night and the blackheads are gone and not returning. I do find that it also treats whiteheads well, but does not necessarily work as a preventative measure for them. Overall, I think it's a great product and would definitely recommend it!

avis.titre: Good product but packaging need refined
avis.texte: I love the product but the jar it comes in is messy. After removing the seal, the lid does not fit correctly leaving a gap when the tweezers are inside and liquid spills. Also, when yo remove the cotton it is soaked, so expect this product to run down your face. I was not happy with the packing but the product itself did a nice job of clearing up blemishes with out over drying.

I've been using this product for the past few days on my acne and I liked how gentle it was. It did not dry out my skin and my pimples have reduced in size/redness. I think this would be a great treatment for those who break out occasionally- especially around their period. I liked how the cotton pads come soaked in the product as it does make using this more convenient. I used one cotton pad every 3 days and would apply sunscreen afterwards.

avis.titre: Highly recommend, but wish the tweezers were a little better
avis.texte: I was pleasantly surprised with how much I enjoyed this! The product itself is fantastic, it has already cleared up some of my active acne without causing any sort of flare ups that I occasionally get with AHA/BHA products. I've only been using it for a few days in the mornings but I already see a difference in my skin. The only thing I don't love is the application method. I understand the point, and I honestly think it works really well with the cotton ball applicator! But the tweezers are a little too thin and the cotton ball slips and falls a lot. If the tweezers could be a little wider I think it might be perfect!
Worked really well for my cystic acne breakouts - overnight they went down and redness diminished. Recommend!

I really like the formula! I used it more as a treatment for my nose and chin blackheads and whiteheads than as a spot treatment and it worked really well! I think the ingredients and serum is great just like all of cosrx's products. The only con is I traveled with it and the lid is not secure. It spills and leaks if tipped sideways which is unfortunate. Also I thought it was hard to use the tongs and cotton ball, I dropped the cotton ball multiple times while using.

I'm so thankful I found this product! In my mid 20s I started to break out and started getting big deep painful breakouts that would often never surface, but would leave dark spots after a few weeks. It was terrible! fast forward to after my first pregnancy. I started to get a lot of hormonal acne on my jawline/neck that would be deep and painful also. Just after a few weeks using this serum it has lowered my breakouts to almost nonexistent, and I haven't had any deep hormonal or cystic acne. As soon as I start to feel a bump, I apply this with the adorable little tongs it comes with as the last step in my skin care routine, and when I wake up, it's either completely gone or almost gone. It hasn't irritated my skin at all and has no smell so I absolutely love that. The tongs make it so convenient I just wish they were more sturdy, I've dropped a few of the cotton balls when picking them up from the jar.

I have infrequent but really annoying breakouts (think single large, painful blemish). This took care of them overnight. My only complaint is that it feels wasteful to throw away the cotton balls when they are still soaked in product.

This acne treatment is very nice. I like the cotton balls but I found better results when I squeezed the product out and applied it like a serum. I used it after toner and before heavier serums. It worked best when I gave it time to dry down on my skin. I had a few breakouts when using this and I think the blemish treatment helped them heal faster than they would with out it. My nose also looks better with smaller, less dark blackheads. I think using it for longer will clear my nose and make my pores less evident. I used it morning and night but I think the results were better overnight because I had more time for it to dry before the next layer. It worked especially well on the days I used Cosrx Snail Mucin Essence right after. The essence also helped it soak in better I felt. Those days my skin looked especially nice. I would recommend this for those looking to heal acne and clear blackheads. I will definitely purchase one for myself when I finished the one Cosrx sent me!

I noticed an improvement in my redness and in my active acne breakouts after just a few uses. Though I do have very sensitive skin, so I only use this every other day to avoid excessive dryness. Overall I will keep using, and so far like the results of this product.

I had a huge pimple on my chin. I applied one of the soaked cotton balls onto it before going to bed. The next morning it was dry! I didn't expect it to work that fast but Im happy with it. It feels cooling and refreshing on the skin, no burning sensation which is usually the case when I use other acne treatments. Ive used it as a spot treatment and so far Im very happy with the results.

avis.titre: Not too drying, good value for size
avis.texte: Like the mini cotton ball format. The tweezers are not pleasant to use. The treatment works well and is not too drying on my skin. So far enjoying the results.

(I received this item for free to give my honest review.) I have a pretty sensitive skin that gets congested very easily, this product did a really good job to resolve existing breakouts without clogging my pores. I personally think that the packaging should be made of glass but overall a really great product and I will be purchasing again.

Whatever reason, I've been experiencing acne breakouts in my 30's. I tried out several products to help when I have an acne breakout and they all seem to help a bit, however since my skin is so red, I'm always left with a bright red bump when my acne is. I tried this product and applied like the directions said with using the very helpful tongs. I was nervous thinking the product would burn if they were supplying tongs for application. However it does NOT burn, or cause me any sensitivity at all. Immediately the next morning, I noticed amazing results! My acne bumps were not raised as much and not as red. My skin didn't feel dried out, or super tight feeling. I applied this product every night for 4 nights and I cannot get over a difference in the appearance of the acne on my face! I'm so excited with how quick it got rid of my acne, while not causing my sensitive skin any further issues or redness and didn't leave my skin dried out!!! For sure going to be a staple in my skin care regimen!

This is a blemish treatment that I know I'll be using whenever necessary. It's so easy to use and has excellent results. I have found that using the treatment has really helped reduce my blemishes and cleared my skin quickly. As someone 50+, I've had acne all of my life. I'm glad I've found COSRX and my family has been noticing my clearer skin. Great product!

Recently, my favorite spot treatment was sold out (and now it has been for months). I have been searching for a new one and came across this. For the price, you get lots of applications (I use a single cotton ball for spot treatment on my face and to reduce KP on my arms). I'm very happy with this purchase, and I definitely see a difference in reducing pimple size and swelling. 10/10!

I really wanted to try this product when I received their newsletter through email. I've been using it for a week and the results are better than I expected. I use this for breakouts on my face, neck, chest, and sometimes on my back. It's been really effective in reducing the size and pain from new breakouts and current ones.

After applying the product directly on the blemish, I do notice that there is a reduction in size after even 2 uses! However, there is a lot of product in a single ball, and you feel obligated to use the remainder elsewhere otherwise it feels wasteful.

I had a breakout from using an icepack after wisdom teeth surgery and it created tons of whiteheads on my chin. This product really helped get rid of them and also helped with the redness and inflammation of my other acne that I usually have. I see improvement in my skin already. This product is nice because each of the cotton balls are truly soaked in the liquid so you definitely get your money's worth and it feels nice and relieving to apply. It somewhat dried out my skin but almost all products do, my moisturizer helped quickly resolve this. The product did what it was supposed to and did it well.

I like how hygienic this product is, since a lil tweezer is provided. And I love how each cotton ball has a lot of serum. I have hormonal acne and this treatment helps me, I use it every night. Highly recommend!!!
I've been using this for about a month. This has really helped with those random pimples that pop up. It reduces the inflammation really well. I will definitely be purchasing again.

avis.titre: Neat new product for deep breakouts
avis.texte: I get really deep individual acne and this has been a great product for me. Super easy to use and such a fun little package with the tweezers. Just dab it on and it helps a lot. I was surprised honestly how quickly it started helping. I'm definitely happy!

pro: does what it claims to do, and does it well. con: tweezer isn't easy to work with, cotton ball holds so much product it drips down your face when you try to dab, the product is strong so it stings
